experiment: F5.5 item 4: scalar-only vs primitive contrast vs retained pair, at equal TOTAL price, sweeping contrast variance and setup
scope: Top-1 identification SIDE model.  No transfer to the Functional group-range claim (audit F5).
feasibility_rule: setup is charged per channel opened BEFORE any sample; a support whose setup exceeds the budget is INFEASIBLE_SETUP with no value and no ratio; one that exactly exhausts it is NO_SAMPLING_BUDGET with information 0
retention_rule: the retained pair keeps BOTH raw values, so cell 0's samples accumulate across every pair and inform every alternative; discarding them would be a different experiment
not_established: The break-even contrast variance is measured PER INSTANCE FAMILY.  It is not a constant, and the two-cell value 4 must not be quoted for K > 2.
S and D are numerical max-min candidates from 25 restarts; A is a closed form.  No global-optimality certificate is claimed for S or D.
Real instrument noise, real prices and the real setup cost are modelling inputs, not findings.
Top-1 alternatives only; this says nothing about the range problem.
lean: none -- this is a numerical instrument-cost study
